senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) Sivan, the third month of the Hebrew calendar, of thirty days, varying between the tenth of May and the eighth of July.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:9">Targ. Esth. VIII, 9</cite>. Targ. II Esth. III, 7; a. e.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 7b:12">R. Hash. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>ששה בס׳ וכ׳</he> the sixth of S. is the New Year for the two loaves (the wheat crop); a. e.
